name: Modern Woodworks
old_description: While many houses may be similar, it's the differences that make them a home. Give Modern Woodworks the opportunity to achieve your goals of creating the home you always wanted. With years of experience improving the homes of our community, we combine skilled craftsmanship with hard-working dedication to give your project the attention and care it deserves. Call Modern Woodworks today for a consultation, and we'll figure out the best way to make your dream home or office a reality.
about:
Modern Woodworks operates from Kenmare, North Dakota. The company's web domain, modernwoodworks2006.com, suggests it has been active since at least 2006, though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership details are not disclosed, but a testimonial identifies Shane as the lead craftsman overseeing projects. The business began as a local woodworking shop serving homeowners in the surrounding community.

The shop provides custom woodworking and finish carpentry for residential projects. Its service list includes entryways, doors, built-in units, bars, columns, kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, crown molding, trim, wainscoting, ceiling treatments, and fireplace surrounds. The company also coordinates surface and sink options through a network of suppliers. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

Modern Woodworks serves residential customers — homeowners building new houses or remodeling existing ones. Testimonials reference kitchen remodels, new-home woodwork, and custom cabinetry. There is no indication of commercial or industrial clients.

The company emphasizes skilled craftsmanship and dedicated attention to each project. A client notes that Shane “stands behind his work” and delivers professional, perfection‑focused results. The firm positions itself on personalized design consultation and clean installation.
